implementation_issues.description: The 2005–2010 base cohort requires fiscal-year 2011 documents for t+1 outcomes and FY2004 documents for lagged Y/industry measures; preserve this source cohort and separately acquire its adjacent-year inputs.
The paper does not specify the MTB, ROA, leverage or cash ratios underlying its controls, nor the market index and residual-estimation window for |ΔStdret|.
Historical SEC office assignments for 2005–2010 are not verified by the current SIC-office roster; office fixed effects cannot be mapped from current office names.
The full 3-digit-SIC peer benchmark population and its eligibility boundary are not established for leader/rival/frequency/industry means.
Audit Analytics COMPANY_FKEY records are locally readable, but a verified historical crosswalk to CIK/GVKEY is not established by the catalogued evidence.
The local feed40 issue-key/text lists do not establish the exact vendor code corresponding to the paper’s risk-factor-column comment tag.
The cosine document vector, word-count handling, filing-section extraction and comment-letter release-date alignment require documented text construction choices.
The source sample and commercial sources are historical; local current Audit Analytics/Compustat/CRSP vintages do not establish exact 2005–2011 event/population coverage.

review_notes: Base cohort t is FY2005–FY2010. Outcome Modif/|ΔLength| uses FY t and t+1; lagged Y_t compares t−1 and t; controls include t+1. Therefore require FY2004–FY2011 disclosure/annual rows, and the actual t+1 10-K filing-date envelope can reach 2012. Release-before-filing uses SEC public release date, not comment letter date. NyearsNCL has no paper-defined lower history bound.
Local exact probes verify access/columns only; no local coverage confirmations were supplied for this item. Public EDGAR routes are recorded where relevant, with historical population gaps preserved.

design_coverage.reason: No weights are reported for this fit.

implementation_issues.description: The 2005–2010 base cohort requires fiscal-year 2011 documents for t+1 outcomes and FY2004 documents for lagged Y/industry measures; preserve this source cohort and separately acquire its adjacent-year inputs.
The paper does not specify the MTB, ROA, leverage or cash ratios underlying its controls, nor the market index and residual-estimation window for |ΔStdret|.
Historical SEC office assignments for 2005–2010 are not verified by the current SIC-office roster; office fixed effects cannot be mapped from current office names.
The full 3-digit-SIC peer benchmark population and its eligibility boundary are not established for leader/rival/frequency/industry means.
Audit Analytics COMPANY_FKEY records are locally readable, but a verified historical crosswalk to CIK/GVKEY is not established by the catalogued evidence.
The local feed40 issue-key/text lists do not establish the exact vendor code corresponding to the paper’s risk-factor-column comment tag.
The cosine document vector, word-count handling, filing-section extraction and comment-letter release-date alignment require documented text construction choices.
The source sample and commercial sources are historical; local current Audit Analytics/Compustat/CRSP vintages do not establish exact 2005–2011 event/population coverage.

review_notes: Base cohort t is FY2005–FY2010. Outcome Modif/|ΔLength| uses FY t and t+1; lagged Y_t compares t−1 and t; controls include t+1. Therefore require FY2004–FY2011 disclosure/annual rows, and the actual t+1 10-K filing-date envelope can reach 2012. Release-before-filing uses SEC public release date, not comment letter date. NyearsNCL has no paper-defined lower history bound.
Local exact probes verify access/columns only; no local coverage confirmations were supplied for this item. Public EDGAR routes are recorded where relevant, with historical population gaps preserved.
